toolsPreview.name: generate_signal
toolsPreview.description: Generate an AI-powered crypto trading signal for a given pair and timeframe. Returns: action (OPEN_LONG | OPEN_SHORT | CLOSE), confidence (0.0–1.0), entry_price, take_profit (array of price levels), stop_loss, risk_reward ratio, indicators (rsi, macd, ema_20, atr), risk_flags (overbought_rsi | oversold_rsi | low_volume | high_spread | near_resistance | near_support), generated_at (ISO 8601), expires_at (ISO 8601), and quota_remaining. The `thesis` field contains LLM reasoning and is only present when include_thesis=true. On quota exhaustion returns error_code=QUOTA_EXCEEDED with Retry-After header. Requires Authorization: Bearer nt_<api_key>.

toolsPreview.name: get_account
toolsPreview.description: Return the current NeuroTrade B2B API quota status: plan tier, calls used, calls remaining, and quota reset date. Requires a valid NeuroTrade B2B API key.
